title: Retain sample exception note
passage:
To: Afternoon quality team

At ten this morning, I pulled two sample jars from Lot 62. Jar R is the one we normally retain. Jar S went to the test bench so we could leave R sealed. The courier roster, printed yesterday, still lists R for this afternoon’s pickup. We thought the customer would want an unopened jar. [143] ____

The customer’s revised instructions arrived after I logged both jars. They now want the jar that produced the test readings, provided the seal on the shipping bag can be verified at pickup. The roster entry is therefore [144] ____, even though the lot number on it is correct.

Attach a separate label to the shipping bag, not to the jar. Keep the original jar IDs; otherwise we will lose the link between the readings and the [145] ____. If the courier can’t verify the bag seal, shelve S beside R without scanning either jar out. The inventory system would otherwise close the collection record automatically. Tomorrow’s courier needs to see today’s seal-check note next to the original request, so [146] ____ when the courier returns.

收件人：下午班品管小組

今天早上十點，我從第 62 批抽出兩罐樣品。R 罐是我們通常會留存的一罐。S 罐送到測試台，這樣就不用拆開 R 罐。昨天印出的快遞取件清單仍列 R 罐為今天下午的取件品項。我們原以為客戶會要求未開封的樣品。[143] ____

我登記完兩罐之後，客戶才送來修改後的指示。客戶現在要實際測得這些讀值的那一罐，前提是取件時能確認運送袋的封條。清單上的品項因此已經[144] ____，即使批號仍然正確。

請在運送袋上另外貼上標籤，不要貼在樣品罐上。原來的樣品罐編號要保留，否則讀值就無法再追溯到[145] ____。若快遞無法確認袋子封條，請將 S 罐放在 R 罐旁，兩罐都不要掃描登記出庫，否則系統會自動結案。明天的快遞必須在原委託旁看到今天查核封條的註記，因此快遞再來時請[146] ____。
reviewPassage:
To: Afternoon quality team

At ten this morning, I pulled two sample jars from Lot 62. Jar R is the one we normally retain. Jar S went to the test bench so we could leave R sealed. The courier roster, printed yesterday, still lists R for this afternoon’s pickup. We thought the customer would want an unopened jar. We put R on the list before hearing back from the customer.

The customer’s revised instructions arrived after I logged both jars. They now want the jar that produced the test readings, provided the seal on the shipping bag can be verified at pickup. The roster entry is therefore out of date, even though the lot number on it is correct.

Attach a separate label to the shipping bag, not to the jar. Keep the original jar IDs; otherwise we will lose the link between the readings and the specific jar that was tested. If the courier can’t verify the bag seal, shelve S beside R without scanning either jar out. The inventory system would otherwise close the collection record automatically. Tomorrow’s courier needs to see today’s seal-check note next to the original request, so continue under the existing record when the courier returns.
